capabilities: Encrypt note titles, content and attachments on disk in a dedicated vault
Lock notes manually or after an inactivity timeout
Retain immutable revisions and encrypted trash with deletion records
Back up and restore the encrypted store from whole-directory copies
Replicate the vault to an operator-provided CouchDB server via Self-hosted LiveSync
extras: Must be installed in a new, empty dedicated vault, not an existing one; mobile is intentionally disabled; uses private Obsidian APIs and needs revalidation after upgrades; no security certification is claimed and there is no passphrase recovery service; marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian stores notes and attachments as plaintext on disk, so sensitive material is readable by anything with file access and File Recovery can persist plaintext.

relations.evidence: a separately installed/configured Self-hosted LiveSync plugin for the full replica
Advanced replication uses an operator-provided HTTPS CouchDB server

summary: Encrypted, append-only notes in a dedicated desktop vault that encrypts titles, content and attachments on disk while unlocked editing uses the native editor, links and search.
